paper.title: MMDU: A Multi-Turn Multi-Image Dialog Understanding Benchmark and Instruction-Tuning Dataset for LVLMs

evidence.section: Abstract; MMDU benchmark construction and evaluation
evidence.figure_or_table: Benchmark overview and main evaluation tables
evidence.paraphrase: Multi-turn dialogues with as many as 20 images and 27 turns test sustained multimodal-context understanding and long-form response generation.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because it evaluates long multimodal dialogue context without making agent memory architecture the central contribution.
